title: Antithesis — Parallel Opposites
skills: define antithesis as a rhetorical and literary device
identify contrasting ideas expressed in parallel structures
analyze how antithesis creates emphasis and sharpens meaning
apply antithesis intentionally in persuasive and creative writing
alignment_note: Explains antithesis as the placement of contrasting ideas in balanced or parallel structures. Supports rhetorical analysis, sentence style, persuasive writing, interpretation of contrast, and analysis of author's craft across high school English courses.
